title: SE implementation scratchpad - Northbridge Bank
content:
Daily scratchpad - customer: Northbridge Bank
Owner: Aisha Khan
Context: initial Dedicated (VPC) deployment + KMS integration for PII-sensitive inference workloads. Customer expects SLA-like behavior: sub-150ms p95 for 1-2K concurrent chat sessions, retention of audit logs for 7 years, and Azure AD SSO for console access.

Meeting notes 2026-02-28:
- Kickoff with NB security + infra (Mark, Priya, DevOps). Customer will provide VPC peering details and KMS Key ARN (Azure Key Vault).
- Agreed to start with a 4xA100-equivalent Dedicated pool for canary. Autoscale policy: scale up by 2 nodes at 60% cpu/gpu util sustained for 5m; max burst +2.
- Dataflow: request bodies will not be persisted; only metadata + audit logs forwarded to customer SIEM via secure webhook.
- Compliance: require HSM-backed KMS for model keys and envelope encryption for logs.

Open action items (personal to-dos):
- [ ] Create initial terraform skeleton for Dedicated cluster (vars: region=us-east-1, instance_profile=rbw-se-nb, gpu_count=4) - due 2026-03-05
- [ ] Draft VPC peering checklist and send to NB infra (need CIDR ranges, allowed subnets, NAT egress path) - send by 2026-03-04
- [ ] Validate Azure Key Vault integration path with engineering (confirm KMS plugin supports AKV with user-assigned managed identity) - block: cloud infra needed - due 2026-03-06
- [ ] Set up canary route in Console: route "northbridge-bank-canary" -> model: redwood-verified-bert-2.0-quant (fallback: redwood-bert-2.0-fp16)
- [ ] Write acceptance tests for latency (synthetic chat with 512 token context) and throughput (parallel 1500 sessions) - use load harness se-loadbench - due 2026-03-08
- [ ] Add audit log subscription to customer webhook and test signature verification (HMAC)

Config notes / snippets (working):
- Terraform skeleton notes:
  provider "redwood" {
    region = "us-east-1"
    org_id = var.org_id
  }
  resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "nb_canary" {
    name = "nb-canary-4x-a100"
    gpu_count = 4
    autoscale {
      min = 4
      max = 6
      policy = "utilization"
      target = 0.6
    }
    network {
      vpc_peering_id = var.nb_vpc_peering_id
      allowed_subnets = var.nb_allowed_subnets
    }
    kms_key = var.nb_akv_key_id
  }

- Canary rollout steps (high level):
  1) Provision dedicated pool + VPC peering in sandbox account (rbw-se-sbx)
  2) Verify network connectivity: test curl to internal health endpoints from NB bastion host
  3) Configure KMS + rotate test key; ensure encryption at rest for model cache and logs
  4) Create canary route in Console, 1% traffic -> canary model; monitor p95 lat, error-rate for 48h
  5) Gradually ramp to 100% if stable, else rollback to fallback model and open SE-incident

Testing commands / debug tips:
- API health check (from NB bastion via peering):
  curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDBWOOD_SANDBOX_TOKEN" https://internal.redwood.local/health
- kube-level pod logs (ops team will provide cluster creds):
  kubectl -n redwood-dedicated logs -l app=inference --tail=200
- Replica / kv-cache stats (via admin endpoint):
  curl -sS -H "X-Admin-Key: <ADMIN>" https://internal.redwood.local/admin/kvstats | jq .

Customer-specific constraints / notes:
- No outbound internet from dedicated nodes (egress only via customer NAT). Must ensure model downloads come from signed S3 mirrors within peered network or we stage model on customer-provided storage.
- Logging retention: customer requires 7y retention; we will push logs to their SIEM via secure webhook + sign with HMAC; also store encrypted archive in their S3 claims bucket.
- Authentication: Azure AD SSO for Console — need SAML metadata and test account (se-nb-test@northbridge.com).

Risks / blockers:
- Engineering to confirm AKV plugin support for enveloped keys (opened ENG-4321).
- Legal to confirm retention + egress policy for long-term log archives (waiting on contract amendment).
- Customer strict network rules might block our initial image pull; plan: request customer pre-stage images or allow temporary egress for model bootstrap.

Quick conversation snippets (for copy-paste into Slack/email):
- To NB infra: "Can you share the VPC peering request with CIDR and subnet allowlist? We'll prepare IAM role and peering on our side. Example vars: nb_vpc_cidr=10.12.0.0/16, nb_bastion_subnet=10.12.1.0/24."
- To Eng (AKV): "ENG-4321: need confirmation that AKV integration supports customer-managed user-assigned identity and envelope encryption for model cache keys. Blocking SE canary."

Notes to self:
- Keep this doc lightweight; migrate final runbook -> google_drive/shared_drives/product/private-deployments/ (once stable)
- Add step-by-step runbook for on-call SRE for canary rollback steps (kubectl commands, route flip).

Version history:
- 2026-02-20: created initial scratchpad (Aisha)
- 2026-02-28: kickoff notes added (Aisha)
- 2026-03-03: added terraform skeleton + updated canary steps (Ben)
